_about: Corrections applied on top of ifta.db by scripts/build-narrators.mjs. Kept here rather than written into ifta.db so each fix is reviewable, version controlled, and survives a rebuild of that database.
_displayNameEn: Transliteration errors in ifta.db's own display_name_en. A skeleton comparison of all 20,954 Arabic and English name pairs found only 0.2 percent materially divergent and no colliding labels among high traffic narrators, so this list is short by design. Each entry records the reason.

13901.why: Arabic reads الطبراني. The record is Sulayman ibn Ahmad ibn Ayyub ibn Mutayyir, Abu al-Qasim, d. 360 AH at Isfahan, the compiler of the three Mu'jams in this corpus. Al-Tabari the historian died 310 AH and is a different person. This narrator ranks second by hadith count, so the wrong label was prominent.

22257.why: Arabic reads محمد بن عمير الطبري. Tabriz and Tabaristan are different places, and عمير is Umayr.

22532.why: Arabic reads أحمد بن عمير الطبري. عمير is Umayr, not Amr, and the nisba is al-Tabari, not ibn Tabari.

4494.why: Arabic reads علقمة بن وقاص العتواري: ʿAlqama, not ʿAqqaḥ; Waqqāṣ with a doubled qāf; and the nisba is to ʿUtwāra of Layth. He is the ʿAlqama who transmits the intention hadith from ʿUmar (Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī no. 1), so the wrong label sat on the corpus's most visited record.

4486.why: Arabic: علقمة بن أبي جمرة الضبعي. ifta.db renders علقمة as ʿAqqaḥ for every narrator of that name. The nisba الضبعي is al-Ḍubaʿī, not ad-Duʿaybī.

4487.was: ʿAqqaḥ ibn Abī ʿAqqaḥ, Mawlā ʿĀʾishah
4487.now: ʿAlqama ibn Abī ʿAlqama, Mawlā ʿĀʾisha
4487.why: Arabic: علقمة بن أبي علقمة مولى عائشة. ifta.db renders علقمة as ʿAqqaḥ for every narrator of that name.

4488.was: ʿAqqaḥ ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān al-Muzanī
4488.now: ʿAlqama ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān al-Muzanī
4488.why: Arabic: علقمة بن عبد الله بن سنان المزني. ifta.db renders علقمة as ʿAqqaḥ for every narrator of that name.

4489.was: ʿAqqaḥ ibn ʿAmr ibn al-Ḥusayn al-ʿAṭāridī
4489.now: ʿAlqama ibn ʿAmr ibn al-Ḥuṣayn al-ʿUṭāridī
4489.why: Arabic: علقمة بن عمرو بن الحصين العطاردي. ifta.db renders علقمة as ʿAqqaḥ for every narrator of that name. الحصين is al-Ḥuṣayn and العطاردي is al-ʿUṭāridī.

4490.why: Arabic: علقمة بن قيس النخعي. ifta.db renders علقمة as ʿAqqaḥ for every narrator of that name. This is the Kufan companion of Ibn Masʿūd, named in 1,934 narrations, the most prominent of the affected entries.

4491.why: Arabic: علقمة بن مرثد الحضرمي. ifta.db renders علقمة as ʿAqqaḥ for every narrator of that name. The nisba الحضرمي is al-Ḥaḍramī; ifta.db doubled a syllable (al-Ḥuḍraḍramī).

4492.why: Arabic: علقمة بن نضلة الكناني. ifta.db renders علقمة as ʿAqqaḥ for every narrator of that name. نضلة is Naḍla and الكناني is al-Kinānī.

4493.was: ʿAqqaḥ ibn Wāʾil ibn Ḥajar al-Ḥuḍraḍramī
4493.now: ʿAlqama ibn Wāʾil ibn Ḥujr al-Ḥaḍramī
4493.why: Arabic: علقمة بن وائل بن حجر الحضرمي. ifta.db renders علقمة as ʿAqqaḥ for every narrator of that name. His father is Wāʾil ibn Ḥujr (حجر), and الحضرمي is al-Ḥaḍramī.

9726.was: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿUlaqmah al-Nabāl
9726.now: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAlqama al-Nabbāl
9726.why: Arabic: أحمد بن محمد بن علقمة النبال. Arabic reads علقمة, which is ʿAlqama. النبال is al-Nabbāl.

11070.why: Arabic: النضر بن علقمة. Arabic reads علقمة, which is ʿAlqama.

12624.why: Arabic: عبد الرحمن بن علقمة السعدي. Arabic reads علقمة, which is ʿAlqama.

15763.why: Arabic: علقمة بن رمثة البلوي. Arabic reads علقمة, which is ʿAlqama.

15852.why: Arabic: علقمة بن سفيان الطائفي. Arabic reads علقمة, which is ʿAlqama.

15853.why: Arabic: علقمة بن علاثة الجعفري. Arabic reads علقمة, which is ʿAlqama. علاثة is ʿUlātha.

15854.why: Arabic: علقمة بن ناجية الخزاعي. Arabic reads علقمة, which is ʿAlqama. الخزاعي is al-Khuzāʿī.

4464.why: Arabic: العلاء بن الحضرمي الأموي. The nisba الحضرمي is al-Ḥaḍramī (ifta.db doubled a syllable), الأموي is al-Umawī, and العلاء takes the article.

4518.was: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Sulaymān al-Ḥuḍraḍramī
4518.now: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Sulaymān al-Ḥaḍramī
4518.why: Arabic: علي بن الحسن بن سليمان الحضرمي. The nisba الحضرمي is al-Ḥaḍramī; ifta.db doubled a syllable.

4474.was: 'Alāʾ ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Rāfiʿ al-Ḥuḍraḍramī
4474.now: al-ʿAlāʾ ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Rāfiʿ al-Ḥaḍramī
4474.why: Arabic: العلاء بن عبد الله بن رافع الحضرمي. The nisba الحضرمي is al-Ḥaḍramī; ifta.db doubled a syllable.

_placeholderIds: Entries that stand for a class of unnamed transmitters rather than one person. They aggregate many different individuals under one id, so they are kept out of the browsable register and out of every narrator count. They are still written to placeholders.json, because an anonymous link in an isnad is a defect worth showing rather than hiding, and hadith display needs a label for them. Only unqualified classes belong here: a qualified entry such as 'a man from Banu Damrah' or 'the wife of Rib'i ibn Hirash' points at one referent and stays in the register flagged as unnamed.
